title: Existence of a U-admissible blowup on which a perfect module of tor dimension at most one vanishing on U acquires two canonical filtrations with prescribed invertible Fitting divisors
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts the existence of a U-admissible blowup b : X' -> X, for a perfect O_X-module F of tor dimension <= 1 that vanishes on an open U, together with two canonical locally finite filtrations of F' = b^*F whose successive quotients F^i/F^{i-1} and F_i/F_{i+1} are finite locally free of rank i on an effective Cartier divisor D_i (statement lines 13265-13288). The proof has to construct the blowup and the divisors simultaneously: it blows up the product of all Fitting ideals Fit_k(F) (which is a finite product because Fit_k(F) = O_X for k past the number of generators in a local presentation), then uses the invertibility of Fitting ideals after blowing up to reduce to the case where each Fit_k(F) is invertible, where the divisors must satisfy the chain of equalities E_k = D_{k+1} + 2 D_{k+2} + 3 D_{k+3} + ... and are therefore determined uniquely (proof lines 13291-13317). The induction on the number n of generators then replaces the matrix A = f A' by A' with f a nonzerodivisor generating Fit_{n-1}, uses f^{n-k} Fit_k(F') = Fit_k(F)|_V, and finally produces the two filtrations from the two factorizations A = A'f = f A' as the kernel and cokernel of multiplication by f (proof lines 13319-13363). The simultaneous determination of the divisors by the Fitting ideals and the canonical kernel/cokernel description of the two filtrations are not a routine consequence of an existing theorem, so the claim is H3.
